scope: Finite stable ideal-Boolean/address/ownership study; digital concept only

assumptions.muxes: Four TMUX6208 8:1 banks, two per source, restricted 24 V driver slice
assumptions.address_capture: Raw unconditional positive COMMIT clock; quiet-qualified D-input hold mux

scenarios.title: Reset and request-high readiness recovery cannot start routing

checks.assertion: Reset startup has no enabled bank
Returning health does not create an active-register clock or permission
High request and route intent prevent rearm

scenarios.title: Both sources route distinct contacts with fixed dedicated returns

checks.assertion: Commit requires separate fresh readback and rearm before permission
Two routes admitted without priority
Low and high contact banks decode addresses 2 and 11
Current-phase command leaves routing fixed
Phase, gap and recovery retain both routes

scenarios.title: Simultaneous demand for the same contact inhibits both sources

checks.assertion: Collision inhibits both banks without winner or priority
Collision resolution alone cannot automatically restart either source
Single-source ownership of equal stored addresses is admissible after explicit rearm

scenarios.title: Commit during a phase, interphase gap or recovery holds active addresses and blocks output

checks.assertion: phase: active address held despite raw COMMIT clock
phase: COMMIT inhibits both bank commands and consumes permission
phase: commit release cannot restart routing
gap: active address held despite raw COMMIT clock
gap: COMMIT inhibits both bank commands and consumes permission
gap: commit release cannot restart routing
recovery: active address held despite raw COMMIT clock
recovery: COMMIT inhibits both bank commands and consumes permission
recovery: commit release cannot restart routing

notes: This stable-state hold result does not establish safe operation for COMMIT edges inside the actual DFF/mux setup/hold aperture.

scenarios.title: Health recovery with COMMIT held high cannot create a delayed address capture

checks.assertion: Unconditional raw COMMIT clock has no new rising edge when health returns
COMMIT high directly inhibits banks
Commit falling edge cannot update positive-edge register
Only a new qualified raw COMMIT edge captures the payload

scenarios.title: Post-commit active-Q verification is required by the external admission protocol

checks.assertion: None: denied external address qualification leaves bank outputs off
(3, 12): denied external address qualification leaves bank outputs off

notes: The comparison in verify_active is an explicit external protocol oracle. It is not silently credited to the router's gates or to a 595 serial return pin.

scenarios.title: A held-high verification cannot survive COMMIT or manufacture a fresh acknowledgement

checks.assertion: COMMIT asynchronously clears readback-seen despite an old high ACK
No new raw ACK edge means no rearm admission
Old epoch/readback cannot satisfy the external fresh-check protocol
Fresh correct acknowledgement followed by new REARM admits

notes: ACK is the raw external rising-edge clock. COMMIT clears READBACK_SEEN independently of the ACK level; no health-gated clock is used.

scenarios.title: A genuinely new but erroneous ACK edge is an exposed external correctness boundary

checks.assertion: Exposed witness: a fresh ACK edge can falsely claim that active bits were checked

notes: UNPROTECTED witness: the native circuit earns a fresh post-COMMIT ACK edge; it cannot prove that the external checker compared the correct bits or intended command.
Reading all eight active FF Q bits establishes digital command state only. Neither that nor 595 QH-prime establishes analogue mux position, low on-resistance, or absence of a failed-on path.

checks.assertion: reset_ready: bank commands interrupt immediately in ideal stable logic
reset_ready: permission recovery cannot resume an existing phase
rails_qualified: bank commands interrupt immediately in ideal stable logic
rails_qualified: permission recovery cannot resume an existing phase

monitor0_ok: permission recovery cannot resume an existing phase

scenarios.title: Powered host freeze requires independent watchdog observation

checks.assertion: Exposed witness: a router is not a pulse timer or host watchdog
Watchdog loss removes bank enables and consumes admission
Watchdog recovery cannot restart route

notes: The watchdog is an external qualified port in this slice. Its implementation, timeout and ability to remain powered through host faults are not earned here.

scenarios.title: Logic-domain brownout makes state unqualified; reset and new verification are required

checks.assertion: Qualified rail-drop input first inhibits banks
No valid logic output is invented through brownout
Readiness alone cannot restore old route permission

scenarios.title: Rearm cannot substitute for COMMIT or manufacture a new active address

checks.assertion: Rearm is not an active-register clock
Router continues using previously verified active command

notes: If firmware intended the shifted rather than active address, this is a command/protocol error. The physical active-Q readback must be compared against the intended route before enabling it.

scenarios.title: Release, settle, COMMIT, active-Q check, separate rearm, then route enable

checks.assertion: COMMIT captures intended new addresses but cannot itself arm output
Fresh address check does not automatically clear block
Only separate rearm permits the newly committed routes

analogue_handoff.off_path_current: Budget separately for both off-bank leakage, capacitance, charge injection, driver output/clamp paths and fixed dedicated return; off is not zero current.
analogue_handoff.collision: Inhibiting both bank commands is a conditional stable state, not proof that a failed-on analogue switch disconnects.
analogue_handoff.commit_aperture: Unqualified near-edge changes of quiet/data/commit are rejected, not assigned a favourable outcome.
analogue_handoff.recording_recovery: AFE_BLANKED is an observed external qualification; router logic does not establish RHD input voltage or filtered-neural recovery.
analogue_handoff.charge_monitor: Delivered current/charge permission is independent; address ownership alone cannot replace monitor or driver timeout permission.
